lead: the delivery that never failed, the man who never walked off, the week that never came apart — settled by half past nine on an ordinary morning, and no record anywhere holds a line about it.
sun: what reaches you at work was never in the report. a supplier says should be fine in a voice that has already given up on it. a good man agrees to saturday half a beat late. a customer thanks you with a decision underneath the thanks. none of that is information anybody could act on, and you act on all of it, weekly, off material that would not survive a single line on a form.
moon: and the move goes out the same hour. The Gate will not wait to see whether a reading firms up — you are phoning a second supplier while the first still says it is fine. so the week you moved on came out clean, and a clean week has no other version to be measured against. the ones that were nothing cost an afternoon and left the same trace.
pull: every collapse you have prevented is unprovable. you went at it in the hour, it did not happen, and a thing that did not happen looks exactly like a thing that was never coming.
tension: the review form wants incidents. you have none. the fitter who took the line apart at midnight has a date, an hour and a fault code, and the story is what gets promoted. what you can put in the box is a year in which nothing occurred, which describes a quiet year just as well as it describes you, and nobody in that building can tell the two apart, including the ones who would swear by you.
cost: a place that has not had a bad quarter in four years is a place with you in it, and nobody working there could name the mechanism. your hit rate is high and not perfect, and a wrong reading costs an afternoon and vanishes as completely as a right one. saves and misfires sit in one unmarked column, and nothing in it is labelled.

lead: your brother calls that house a happy one and he is not lying. he was nine. what he was kept clear of was kept clear of by somebody, and he has never once wondered who.
sun: you had the actual condition of both your parents by eight, off nothing either of them said — which one had already decided, what the good sunday voice was laid over, how much arithmetic was being done after everyone went up. no adult gave you a word of it. and because you knew, you worked the hours: who got taken out, who got kept in, which evenings needed something else going on in them.
moon: The Bearer holds to term and opens on a decision, and in thirty years the decision has not come. nothing loosened it — no bad night, no argument, no drink. so what went in at eight is still in there at its original size, with your hand the only one on the gate. it stopped being something carried a long while ago. now it is simply stored.
pull: the childhood your siblings describe is accurate because a nine-year-old was working. they were never meant to know that, which is why it worked, and it is far too late to tell them.
tension: what comes back at you is coldness. you were the serious one, you never let anything go, you were difficult about christmas for years. answering that means producing a list of evenings and what was going on inside each, and handing two adults the information that their childhood was staffed. so the charge stands. the version in which you were a hard child is what lets the other two keep the house they remember.
cost: ten minutes inside any home and the real state of it is yours, which is why people bring you their marriages. the same faculty was running at eight, in a kitchen with no exit and nowhere to put it. both your parents died certain they had handled it well, and that certainty was the last piece of your work, delivered to people who never knew there had been any.

lead: it never leaves as one amount. a tank of fuel, a bill settled at the counter before it reaches the table, a coat bought twice so one can be handed on. every piece is too small to name.
sun: the state of a person's money is the thing almost nobody says and almost everybody transmits. a round declined a half-second early. a joke about the boiler, made twice now. a sentence about the school trip with the arithmetic already finished inside it. nobody has ever told you any of it, and you have been right for years about which people in a comfortable room are in trouble.
moon: and what you do about it will not consolidate. The Gathered Stars keep it plural — six unnamed pieces across a winter, each small enough to pass as nothing, the only form in which any of it would have been taken. stand back and it reads as one open-handed person. up close there is no single act in the whole arrangement anybody could point at.
pull: four households came through bad winters on you and each would say, honestly, that nobody helped. every piece was too small to count as a gift, which is the only reason it landed.
tension: hopeless with money is the fond version, and it gets said by people watching you buy a round. you are the one with nothing behind them at an age where that gets noticed. the accounting exists and you could produce it to the pound, and producing it means naming six people and the thing you heard in each voice that the voice did not say. so it stays a character flaw, and the flaw is holding the structure up.
cost: a thin year resolves the arrangement inside a month. the pieces stop, and nothing visible changes anywhere, because nothing visible was ever happening. asking for anything back would require an account of what went out, and none of the people carried holds a memory of having been carried. the full total sits with the one person who paid it, in no second copy.

lead: a room adjusting around a body makes a sound — the beat before the compliment, one word swapped for a safer one — and you have been getting it since fourteen, and it has all gone to one place.
sun: bodies are what rooms discuss least directly and transmit most. you get the half-second in which somebody chose a different word. you get the warmth in a greeting that was decided on rather than felt. you get what is said about a person the moment they leave the table. it arrives whether or not it concerns you, and the ones that do arrive at the same volume as the rest, in the dark.
moon: and every last piece of it feeds one standard, taken off one person in one year, still sitting a length in front. The Follower has no intention of closing that gap. what comes in gets converted into distance — how far back you are this morning — so an overheard remark about somebody else's arms, in a kitchen, a decade ago, is doing work on what you eat today.
pull: nobody has ever said one word to you about your body. you have had the room's real position on bodies at full volume for twenty years, out of conversations about other people.
tension: discipline is what it gets called, and the warmer version is that you are simply built that way. eating before the dinner so nothing has to be managed at it, the hour before five while the house is asleep, the route home that avoids a particular window — none of that has a witness, by construction, because a witnessed version starts a conversation you would have to sit through. so daily labour reads as constitution.
cost: you can hear down a phone line what somebody has actually been eating and roughly how long they have been lying about it, which is why the true version gets told to you and nobody else. the same instrument runs on you all day and returns nothing usable. a standard set off one person does not take evidence, and twenty years of hearing has moved it nowhere.
